name: dsh-design-review
description: Mandatory cross-review of design documents and lessons-learned with an external ops agent (e.g. Hermes): auto-detects design doc writes in any session, files a review-handoff request (type=design), queues safely under the single-slot protocol, and injects the verdict back into the originating session; lesson_review_submit files type=lesson reviews whose approved measures are appended to OPS-GUARDRAILS.md.
